top5.title: A software update allegedly grounded flights across the United States
top5.description: An update to L3Harris’s private network reportedly caused a communications outage for U.S. air traffic control. The FAA lifted the ground stop after more than four hours, but delays are expected to continue for several days.
top5.why: A software outage that grounded U.S. flights exposes critical infrastructure dependence on private networks and could trigger major scrutiny of aviation technology resilience.

top5.title: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system
top5.description: A Federal Reserve survey found that artificial intelligence risks are considered the greatest threat to the financial system.
top5.why: The Federal Reserve’s assessment that AI is the largest threat to financial stability signals rising systemic-risk concerns for banks, regulators and investors.

top5.title: Anthropic’s IPO is reportedly six times oversubscribed
top5.description: Anthropic’s IPO is reportedly six times oversubscribed and could become the largest in history.
top5.why: Anthropic’s reportedly heavily oversubscribed IPO would demonstrate extraordinary investor appetite for leading AI companies and potentially reset private and public-market valuations.

top5.title: Government-Grade Spyware Is Now Targeting iPhones
top5.description: Researchers say sophisticated spyware previously reserved for government surveillance is being used against private individuals. Two iOS exploit kits, Coruna and DarkSword, are involved.
top5.why: Government-grade iPhone spyware reaching private targets marks a serious escalation in mobile security and raises urgent questions for enterprises, governments and Apple.

top5.title: Solar power and batteries are reportedly the cheapest option for AI data centers
top5.description: A study estimates that on-site solar power paired with batteries is becoming the cheapest option for AI data centers in 85% of U.S. regions. It attributes this advantage to faster construction, which allows computing capacity to be added more quickly.
top5.why: Solar paired with batteries emerging as the cheapest power source for AI data centers in most U.S. regions could reshape the economics, location and speed of AI infrastructure build-outs.
